items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: the Pullman Porter kept his mouth shut

ctx.x: I booked it, you know, in all the things.

Well, how did they... I wasn't defying anything. When you were getting on the car, don't they separate, then the Pullman, the Porter, or whatever, separate black and white? Well, yeah, luckily, the Pullman Porter kept his mouth shut.
You know, he could have said, I'm sorry, you know.
